newsitem.title: USA: Kenny named snr VP Walt Disney TV International.
newsitem.headline: Kenny named snr VP Walt Disney TV International.

text.p: Walt Disney Co Tuesday said it named Simon Kenny to the post of Senior Vice President and Managing Director of Walt Disney Television International for Latin America.

In a statement, Disney said Kenny will oversee the regional office located in Miami and continue to report to Etienne de Villiers, President of Walt Disney Television International. In his new role, Kenny will develop and manage all of WDTV-I's interests in Latin America including production, distribution, broadcasting, sales and marketing and the development of Disney Channels in Latin America.
Kenny had been Vice President and Managing Director, Buena Vista International Television, since 1993.
Keith LeGoy, who has been promoted to Vice President, Europe, will take over Kenny's European sales responsibilities.
